integrity: The analytic proof establishes all degrees; finite exact-rational and numerical Gram tests are corroborative rather than infinite certificates. No authorship, publication priority, or independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree evaluation on exactly two symmetric half-step-staggered rings; rational nonzero heights of even reduced denominator. No uniform in-degree stability; equivalent earlier Fourier aliasing formulations remain possible.
title: Exact-degree spherical harmonic spectra on staggered rational-latitude double rings
